Type.evidence_source: While men's suicidality was the focus of the current photovoice study, social isolation, as a correlate much referenced by participants, informed our attention to, and fine-grained analysis of that phenomena. In this respect, the research question, "How is social isolation experienced among men with a history of suicidality?" was inductively derived based on what participants shared in their interviews and through their photographs. Grounded in the interpretive descriptive traditions of qualitative research (Thorne, 2016), the current study also utilized photo-elicitation techniques (Oliffe & Bottorff, 2007), an approach with roots in social justice and communitybased participatory action research (Wang & Burris, 1997).
